title: NextCloud Coockie Banner
body:
Hey,

I am requesting a NextCloud Coockie Banner. It’s important for Websites in Europe. So also NextCloud should have it. It’s ok if you can enable and disable it in the Config and set a link or text for the Coockie Banner. That’s would be awesome and for me and I think also for other people very important. 

JanDragon
